title: Coconut chips: nut-sounding ingredient that is not a regulated allergen

blocks.text: Nutritional Information (per 100 g): Energy 660 kcal, Protein 3.3 g, Carbohydrate 24.0 g, Total Sugars 18.0 g, Total Fat 62.0 g, Sodium 90 mg
Manufactured by: Island Harvest Foods Pvt Ltd, 3 Coastal Road, Kochi 682001, Kerala, India
Store in an airtight container in a cool dry place

notes: Coconut is not classified as a tree nut allergen under either the FSSAI or the UK/EU regulated allergen lists (it is a drupe, not a botanical nut), so no Contains statement is required or present. This is a deliberate false-positive trap for systems that conflate the word coconut or the general idea of a nut-like product with the regulated tree nut allergen category.
